correctness.rationale: The sinc-power Fourier formula, Poisson alias representation and uniform two-term approximation give the local complex profile. A global nearest-alias lower bound forces all normalized-small values into a 1/m-frequency strip; dominated convergence gives the full fundamental-cell area law and explicit A(tau). Exact half-integer derivative sums are positive and yield the Jacobian constant. The decoded checker independently tests time/Fourier representations and finite convergence; the infinite conclusions are proved analytically.

value.rationale: Unlike the already known Zak zero location, the full small-modulus area quantifies how near-singular Zak-fiber values concentrate for increasing cardinal-spline order. Its universal boundary-layer shape, explicit threshold-distribution invariant and exponentially small transverse Jacobian supply precise conditioning information for a natural family of compactly supported Gabor windows. No unproved downstream theorem is asserted.
